hole1.cameraReferenceMethod: Numbered platform identity checked against the Caddee hole-1 plan and the three observed coastal platforms. References stay inside their associated platform; daily marker positions and current surveyed coordinates are unknown.

numberedPlatformReview.method: Read the printed tee numbers and platform groups in the plan, then match the platform sequence and path/shore relationships to the orthophoto. Plan pixels are identity evidence, not georeferenced control points.
numberedPlatformReview.reading: Three platforms run north from the lighthouse beside the coastal path. The rear rectangle carries 63 and 59; the middle carries 55 and 51; the front carries 46 and 41. Tee 59 must not move to the middle platform merely to satisfy a card-length offset.
numberedPlatformReview.dailyMarkerPositions: unverified; displayed points are representative locations inside the associated platform
